description: DHCP option 55 (Parameter Request List) from DHCPDISCOVER and DHCPREQUEST, matched as the exact list of option codes in the order the client sent them. Signatures are tried in order and the first match wins.

signatures.label: windows
signatures.notes: Windows 8 and later, including 10, 11 and Server releases, all send this list, so it does not narrow the version.

signatures.label: windows-legacy
signatures.notes: Windows Vista and 7 with WPAD (option 252) requested.

signatures.label: macos
signatures.notes: macOS 12 and later (adds option 108 IPv6-only preferred and 114 captive portal).

signatures.label: ios
signatures.notes: iOS and iPadOS 15 and later. Also seen on watchOS and tvOS.

signatures.label: ios
signatures.notes: Older iOS and iPadOS. Also seen on watchOS and tvOS.

signatures.label: android
signatures.notes: Android 9 and earlier, which used dhcpcd. Other dhcpcd builds may send the same list.

signatures.label: android
signatures.notes: Android 10 and later (the framework's own DHCP client). The vendor class is a better tell.

signatures.label: linux
signatures.notes: ISC dhclient as shipped by Debian and Ubuntu (desktop installs before NetworkManager's internal client).
